title: ci-system-deps.sh: the runner image's cmake is on PATH, not a dpkg package, so every job still ran apt-get update
goal: T-RELEASEPERF-1 moved release.yml onto scripts/ci-system-deps.sh expecting the apt-get update to be skipped. The v0.21.12-era dry run (run 37485980532) showed 'installing missing system dependencies: cmake' on every Linux leg (12-19 s each): the ubuntu-24.04 image carries cmake under /usr/local/bin, so dpkg -s cmake fails and the script refreshed the index and installed a second cmake 3.28 that PATH never picks. Count a package as present when dpkg knows it or the binary it provides resolves on PATH; pin it with a hermetic isolated-PATH test.
